author: Schwampelienchen

title: good with room for improvement
body:
Overall a rather good app, but:
-you cannot set a time for the new day to start. 12 am is annoyingly inappropriate for me.
-you cannot alter the time of an event (useful for actions you do/can not record right away)
-overall, editing the records is rather unintuitive
author: Simbchen

title: Strides app is a very helpful tool
body:
If you want to track your habits, goals and daily life - Strides app is a very powerful tool to recognize, study and change patterns in your life.
The application is a bit expensive!
author: Web342xa

title: Variety of options is amazing
body:
Finally an app that understands rolling averages, lower is better, add to total etc. 
And it's so beautiful, so easy to use.
